title: CSV export crashes on empty list
body: A filtered result with no rows crashes instead of producing an empty download. Reproduction: call export_rows([]) using the default format. The caller should receive an empty document rather than an IndexError. Please investigate the current code and the existing empty-input decision before selecting a fix.

comments.body: The traceback points to csv.DictWriter fieldnames=rows[0].keys(). It happens only when the result is empty; a single row still downloads normally.
comments.author: maya

comments.body: Retest by exporting a filter with no matches, then one with a row. Empty should not crash; the nonempty CSV must still have its header and values. There is an empty-input test in member-a but please check whether it is actually enabled.
comments.author: dana

title: export_rows should accept fmt='json'
body: Our integration wants JSON records instead of parsing a CSV download. The function already has a fmt argument, so I tried fmt='json', but the result still looks like CSV. Please establish whether this is already implemented or covered by approved work; leave CSV as the default.

comments.body: There is a draft called Export format option, plan 0003, covering explicit JSON and unsupported format errors. Check its status rather than assuming the argument name means the behavior has landed.
comments.author: dana

title: Do we need Parquet exports?
body: Product question: do customers need Parquet as a supported export format, or is CSV plus an explicit JSON option enough? Supporting a new format would be a product commitment; this is not an implementation request or approval to add a dependency. Product needs to choose the supported formats and the customer use case before engineering can scope this.

comments.body: I own the product decision. Hold implementation until I confirm a customer need and whether Parquet is in the supported-format promise. No decision has been made; do not infer one from the JSON plan.
comments.author: noor
